task: Summarise the open incident for the on-call channel.
exclusivity: One output gets exactly one output_format label. JSON is tested before YAML, so text that is valid JSON is never labelled yaml_mapping — this is the JSON-is-also-YAML trap the plan calls out, closed by ordering.

options.text: Return the summary as a JSON object.
Return the summary as a JSON array.
Return the summary as a YAML mapping.
Return the summary as a Markdown table.
Return the summary as CSV with headers.

task: Emit the response body for the /accounts endpoint.
exclusivity: A field name matches at most one casing pattern. Mixed casing across fields returns 'other', so a hedged output cannot score as two.

options.text: Name every field in snake_case.
Name every field in camelCase.
Name every field in PascalCase.
Name every field in kebab-case.
Name every field in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

task: Export the tickets that closed last week.
exclusivity: The five date patterns cannot co-occur in one rendering of one date. If more than one pattern appears anywhere in the output the label is 'other', which fails all five.

options.text: Write every date in ISO 8601 style.
Write every date in US slash style.
Write every date in European dot style.
Write every date as Unix epoch seconds.
Write every date in RFC 2822 style.

task: Report the conversion rate for each of the five cohorts.
exclusivity: A number has one fractional-digit count, or a percent sign, or an exponent — never two. Four-digit bare integers are excluded first so years are not read as data.

options.text: Round every number to a whole integer.
Give every number to one decimal place.
Give every number to three decimal places.
Give every number in full scientific notation.
Give every number as a signed percentage.

task: Dump the lookup table so the loader can read it.
exclusivity: The label requires one delimiter to appear a constant number of times on every line. Two delimiters both satisfying that returns 'other', so a comma-and-pipe hybrid fails both.

options.text: Separate the columns with commas.
Separate the columns with tabs.
Separate the columns with pipes.
Separate the columns with semicolons.
Separate the columns with two spaces.

task: Mint an identifier for each new job record.
exclusivity: The five patterns are disjoint by length and character class. Note hex8 and bare_integer overlap on strings like 12345678, so hex8 is tested first and the fixture set includes exactly that string.

options.text: Mint each id as a lowercase UUID v4.
Mint each id as eight lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Mint each id as job- plus a counter.
Mint each id as a bare decimal integer.
Mint each id as a hyphenated word slug.

task: Write the section titles for the migration guide.
exclusivity: A title line has one leading marker. Deeper hashes are tested before shallower ones so '### x' is never read as h1.

options.text: Mark every section title as a level-1 heading.
Mark every section title as a level-2 heading.
Mark every section title as a level-3 heading.
Mark every section title as a bold line.
Mark every section title as an ALL CAPS line.

task: List the amount outstanding on each of the accounts.
exclusivity: Brackets, symbol prefix and code suffix are tested before the bare forms, so '$12.40' never counts as bare_decimal. integer_cents requires no decimal point at all.

options.text: Show each amount with a leading dollar sign.
Show each amount with a trailing currency code.
Show each amount as an integer of cents.
Show each amount as a bare two-decimal number.
Show each negative amount in accounting style brackets.

task: Write out the pre-deploy checklist steps.
exclusivity: Every line gets one marker label and the whole output must agree. Roman numerals are tested before prose so 'iv. check certs' is not read as prose.

options.text: Start every item with a hyphen bullet.
Start every item with an asterisk bullet.
Start every item with an arabic number.
Start every item with a roman numeral.
Write the items as prose with no markers.

task: Stamp each log line you emit for the audit trail.
exclusivity: A stamp carries a Z, or a numeric offset, or a named zone, or none. date_only requires the line to be a date and nothing else, so it cannot co-occur with a time-of-day form.

options.text: Stamp each line in UTC with a trailing Z.
Stamp each line with a numeric UTC offset.
Stamp each line with a named IANA zone.
Stamp each line as epoch seconds, no zone.
Stamp each line with the date and no zone.
